usage: Opening and background music use YuE2-3B by Multimodal Art Projection, via audio.cpp GGUF. Phrases are mixed with narration, level changes and fades. These demos include CC BY-NC 4.0 music and are for non-commercial use. Retain attribution when sharing.
verification: Audio-file integrity and source-text coverage are checked. “The Open Window” and “A Mad Tea-Party” use one completed take per passage, with bounded retries for incomplete recordings. The Russian demos include targeted development checks and replacement takes following listener feedback. Automatic full-book speech-recognition and acoustic checks are off. No recording has received complete human listening approval. Original texts are credited at their sources; public-domain status varies by territory.
